## EMST role: Air quality specialist (state variant, lead level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.45, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R28-air-quality-specialist/state:2655`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Build emissions inventories and air quality models for attainment planning — lead L4
- Operate ambient air monitoring networks to regulatory quality-assurance criteria — lead L4
- Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority — lead L4
- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — lead L3
- Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs — lead L4
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — lead L3
- Plan smoke management for prescribed and managed fire within air quality requirements — lead L3
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — lead L3
- Build organizational and jurisdictional greenhouse gas inventories for disclosure and reporting — lead L3
- Analyze cumulative burdens and distributional effects of environmental decisions — lead L3
- Build, run and validate environmental forecast and scenario systems — lead L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — lead L1

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Compile a point, area, mobile and natural source emissions inventory for a planning year with documented methods and activity data
- Run a photochemical model for an attainment demonstration under an approved modelling protocol, documenting model performance against monitored data
- Review a permit applicant's dispersion modelling analysis against the agreed protocol and guidance before accepting its conclusions
- Check emissions estimates generated automatically from activity or sensor data against source tests and inventory methods before inclusion
- Determine whether a proposed modification at a stationary source triggers major new source review from emissions increases and netting
- Draft operating permit conditions for a major stationary air source with monitoring sufficient to show compliance with each applicable requirement
- Review a control technology determination submitted with an air permit application against comparable sources and cost criteria
- Check permit conditions drafted from a template or AI tool against the source's applicable requirements before public notice
- Audit a regulatory air monitor's flow and gas calibration against transfer standards following the quality assurance project plan
- Validate a quarter's ambient monitoring data against quality-assurance criteria, flagging or invalidating values before data certification
- Collocate low-cost sensors with a regulatory monitor to derive correction factors, documenting sensor performance before the data are published
- Inspect a permitted facility or site against its permit conditions and applicable rules, recording observations, measurements and samples as evidence

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* 1 not shown until the issuer is verified

## EMST role: Natural resource and environmental programme manager (state variant, senior/lead level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:relatedMatch`, confidence 0.3, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R13-resource-program-manager/state:2655`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Formulate, justify and execute public budgets across appropriations cycles — senior L3, lead L4
- Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands — senior L3, lead L4
- Brief decision-makers and elected officials for authoritative decisions — senior L3, lead L4
- Design developmental work experiences that preserve the formation of professional judgment — senior L3, lead L4
- Elicit, document and transfer tacit and institutional knowledge before people leave — senior L3, lead L3
- Design and administer cross-jurisdictional stewardship agreements — senior L3, lead L4
- Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements — senior L3, lead L4
- Assess the durability and reversal risk of policy choices and time actions to policy windows — senior L3, lead L4
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — senior L3, lead L3
- Govern enterprise environmental data and AI portfolios — lead L4
- Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance — senior L3, lead L3
- Navigate legislative and governing-body processes for environmental programs — senior L3, lead L4
- Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards — senior L3, lead L4
- Apply systems thinking across ecological, institutional and technical systems — senior L3, lead L3
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — senior L3, lead L4
- Develop proposals and grant applications for environmental work — senior L3, lead L3
- Specify, evaluate and accept AI and analytics services in procurement — senior L3, lead L3
- Design human-in-the-loop review for AI-assisted environmental workflows — lead L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — senior L2, lead L2
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — senior L2, lead L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — senior L2, lead L3
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — senior L2, lead L2
- Conduct job analyses and write job-related assessments for technical positions — senior L3, lead L4
- Justify positions and staffing with workload and mission evidence — senior L3, lead L4
- Set programme strategy and lead organizational and technological change in environmental programmes — senior L3, lead L4
- Run the adaptive management cycle and evaluate programme performance — senior L3, lead L4
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3, lead L4
- Communicate technical environmental information in writing and speech — senior L3, lead L4
- Apply merit-based, job-related practices in recruitment and team management — senior L3, lead L4
- Develop and compare policy and land-use scenarios for environmental decisions — senior L3, lead L4

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Prepare a program budget request and justification linking each funding increment to outputs and outcomes the budget office can verify
- Reconcile program obligations and expenditures against appropriations, agreements and fee accounts each month, flagging any use outside purpose or period
- Prepare a continuing-resolution and funding-lapse contingency plan, ranking program activities by legal requirement and consequence of delay
- Brief appropriations staff or a governing board on a program budget request, answering questions with figures traceable to the justification
- Design a fee or cost-recovery schedule for a permit or service program within its statutory authority, documenting the cost basis for each fee
- Assess the reversal risk of a program's key instruments, recording the evidence, the likely triggers and a contingency for each high-risk instrument
- Classify each instrument a program relies on by type and the process needed to change it, recording who can change it and how quickly
- Write a decision memo for an accountable official, stating the decision required, options, evidence, risks and a recommendation within two pages
- Brief a decision-maker orally on a pending decision under time pressure, answering questions and stating where the evidence is uncertain
- Advise an official in writing when the evidence does not support a preferred option, recording the advice given in the decision file
- Prepare a staff report for a governing body's public meeting, stating findings, options and the legal basis for each recommended action
- Track bills, ordinances and appropriations measures affecting the program, summarizing each relevant provision's effect on program operations
